summary: Frontend-only test of Chapter PDF Reader + Draft Preview through the isolated bridge (FE https://pdf-engine-v2--49kthst3.preview.emergentagent.com, /api routed to 127.0.0.1:8770 with bridge cookies). All 7 requested flows PASS: type page uploads/chips/30 chapter drafts; chapter table rename -> 'Save 1 change' -> toast -> persists after reload; no-headings page marker (16 page pictures all HTTP 200, Q1 hints on p1/p9, mark p1+p9 as new chapters, names, subject, problem text gating, remove chapter also removes its marks, save -> reading poll -> 2 rows with given names, 'Read the PDF by itself again' shown and works); upload dialog subject select + chunked upload of chapters_layout_b.pdf -> 2 drafts Kinematics=Physics, Mole Concept=Chemistry within ~10s; Try as student -> 'Preparing…' -> /sets/<id>?preview=true with PRIVATE REVIEW eyebrow, notice, 'Back to Master' returns to type page; preflight -> Start private preview -> 50-question player -> answer -> submit -> results page; reviewer scope, reviewer blocked from /super-admin/chapters/<id> (redirect to /super-admin), reviewer Try as student on held mock FixMock works; mobile 390 no overflow on type/chapters/marker, 2-column page grid, sticky bottom bar usable. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Renaming only the title (subject untouched) flips provenance to 'Subject: chosen by you' because the unchanged subject is stored in chapter_overrides. Frontend sends {label,title,subject} for every changed row; backend should only override subject when it differs (or frontend should omit unchanged subject).

Subject chosen by the owner in the page marker (Physics for chapter 1) is labelled 'Subject: printed in the pdf' afterwards; chapter_record only reads chapter_overrides for 'you' source, so owner-picked subjects from the marker get the wrong provenance label.

ui_bugs.issue: Fix page heading shows raw label 'Chapter 1'/'Chapter 2' instead of chapter title (e.g. 'TEST_Motion Basics', 'Kinematics') while the Things-to-fix list shows the real title.
Heading stays 'Loading…' alongside 'Mock not found.' error, and 'Try as student' is still offered.

ui_bugs.component: ChapterSplit 'Read the PDF by itself again'
ui_bugs.issue: Runs immediately with no confirm; for a no-headings PDF it wipes the owner's marks, names and subjects and returns to an empty marker.

integration_issues.flow: Draft preview of a held chapter (TEST_Motion Basics, '1 to fix')
integration_issues.issue: Preview opened with all 50 questions and no 'left out until fixed' toast. Probably fine if the issue is a page-level 'leading content' warning and not a question to fix, but please confirm left_out behaviour matches the chip count.

issues: Source line shows 'Owner-uploaded Physics chapter book.pdf'. The upload dialog calls this name 'private', so check that live chapter sets don't show the upload filename to students.
Back link says 'Back to BITSAT tests & results' rather than going back to Master. Small gap for owner/reviewer.

action_items: Only store subject override in /details when the subject actually changed (provenance label)
Give owner-chosen subjects from the page marker the 'Chosen by you' source
FixMock heading: use chapter title for chapter-wise mocks; replace 'Loading…' on error
Optional: confirm dialog before chapter-use-headings discards owner marks
Check that the upload filename isn't shown as the student-facing source for live chapter tests
critical_code_review_comments: ChapterSplit.js MarkForm useEffect on role with eslint-disable is fragile; logic works in tests but is hard to reason about
ChapterTable save sends every field of changed rows (causes the provenance issue above)
Page picture queue (max 3 + 503 retry) works: 16/16 images 200 on desktop

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (7/7) pass; 5 minor issues

seed_data_creation: In bridge disposable DB only: renamed Physics chapter 1 to 'TEST_Units and Dimensions'; marked no-headings book into TEST_Motion Basics/TEST_Atoms Basics then reset with 'Read the PDF by itself again' (now back to chapters_needed); uploaded 'TEST_Layout B upload'; 1 owner preview attempt submitted. No preview/customer DB writes.

Player submit confirm is [data-testid=confirm-accept]; preflight: fill device-test-answer, click preflight-run-check, preflight-acknowledge, set-preflight-start-button. No-headings book is now back in chapters_needed state.
